title: Add config explain endpoint + provenance metadata for effective batching config
author: Ethan Park
description:
Motivation: Console needs a reliable way to show (a) the effective batching parameters applied at request time and (b) *why* those values were chosen (explicit override vs tier default vs model registry override vs runtime fallback). This also unblocks support/debugging for “tier vs explicit override” confusion (see SUP-18510) and makes precedence rules visible.

What’s in this PR: 1) New endpoint `GET /v1/config/explain` (and internal alias `GET /internal/config/explain`) that returns the effective config for a given “selection context” (route, model, deployment, streaming) plus provenance metadata per field. 2) Extend config evaluation to emit field-level provenance: `explicit`, `tier_default`, `model_registry`, `runtime_default`, and `clamped` (when validation/guardrails clamp a value). 3) Add a stable “explain schema” version + headers so Console can safely render and cache results. 4) Add audit-friendly fields: `policy_version`, `model_registry_version`, `config_hash`.

Key behavior: - Precedence is unchanged (explicit knobs win; otherwise tier defaults; otherwise model-family override; otherwise runtime default). - Explain only returns non-secret configuration. It does not return tokens/keys, customer prompt contents, or internal hostnames.

API shape (example): `GET /v1/config/explain?route=chat.completions&model=rw-open-llama-3-70b&stream=true&batching_tier=fast` returns `effective_config` and `provenance` keyed by config path. (See tests for full examples.)

Notes: - Endpoint is behind `config_explain_endpoint` feature flag in Hosted, always enabled in dev/staging. - Intended consumer is Console; also useful for `rwctl` and Support tooling.

Testing: - Unit tests for precedence + provenance labeling. - Golden tests for response stability and schema versioning. - Integration tests hit the endpoint with explicit overrides + tier selection.

Follow-ups: - Console PR will wire dropdown + tooltips to provenance strings (ENG-18425). - We may want to add a “request_id -> explain context” helper once tracing integration is ready (out of scope here).
commits: platform/api: add /v1/config/explain handler and request validation
runtime/config: compute effective config + field-level provenance map
tests: golden snapshots for explain response (schema v1)
docs: internal docs for explain endpoint + support troubleshooting notes
conversation:
Chloe Martin (Console): Can we guarantee the response is stable enough for the UI to render without chasing backend changes weekly? Also, we need human-readable text for the provenance (not just enums) so we can show tooltips.

Ethan Park (author): Added `schema_version: "v1"` and a `provenance_reason` string alongside the enum. Console can key off schema_version; we’ll bump only on breaking changes.

Benji Okafor: Endpoint auth concerns: should this be customer-accessible or console-only? If customer-accessible, we need to ensure it doesn’t leak internal policy data.

Ethan Park (author): Implemented RBAC check: requires `config:read` scope. Response redacts internal-only fields unless `x-redwood-internal: true` header is present and caller is an internal service principal. Also removed raw model-registry rule text; we only return the selected `model_registry_version` + `source=model_registry`.

Diego Santos: The precedence order in the description doesn’t match the existing runtime (model registry overrides tier for certain model families). Is this PR changing precedence?

Ethan Park (author): Good catch—this PR does not change precedence. Updated docstring + tests to reflect actual behavior: explicit overrides > model-registry hard overrides > tier defaults > runtime defaults. (Tier still applies unless registry marks a knob as pinned.)

Allison Grant: Please add metrics for endpoint usage and latency; we’ll want to know if Console starts polling too aggressively.

Ethan Park (author): Added `config_explain_requests_total{status}` and `config_explain_latency_ms` histogram. Also set `Cache-Control: max-age=15` on successful responses.

Chloe Martin (follow-up): For streaming routes, can we include whether decode prioritization was applied by tier mapping?

Ethan Park (author): Added `effective_config.scheduling.decode_priority` and provenance for it. See updated golden test `streaming_fast_tier.json`.

Outcome: Approved after changes; merged via squash.
checks: CI: build-runtime (pass), unit-tests (pass), lint (pass), openapi-check (pass), integration-tests (pass), perf-smoke (skipped: not required for API-only changes). One flaky integration test rerun on 2025-02-20 due to staging timeout; rerun passed.
release_notes: Internal: Added /v1/config/explain endpoint to retrieve effective batching/scheduling config with field-level provenance for Console and Support debugging. No behavior change to batching; visibility only.
